input_signals.reasoning:
This abandons the count-plus-tie-break bolt-together for a construction the archive has never used on either leg: five-year *cumulative* flows measured against beginning-of-period stocks, so the comparison is a cycle-level accounting statement (total profit earned versus total capacity added) rather than a contemporaneous state or an annual event.
